profile.headline: Senior Web Developer at Avantax Wealth Management℠
profile.summary:
•	Over  29 years of professional experience in position as Software Engineer.
•	Experienced in the full project life cycle from gathering requirements to testing and implementation.
•	Skilled in information systems management, analysis, troubleshooting, testing, documentation, internal control procedures, system and program security, systems analysis and software installation, applications and program management, technical support.
•	Leadership skills include guiding behavior and learning, aligning team members around organizational strategy and values, training others and building unity within the team.
•	Well-developed communication skills, ability to work well independently and as part of a team, developing effective client relations, providing superior client service and satisfaction.
•	Exceptional work ethics and an enthusiastic learner.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Work in a team environment to enhance the features of their Stock and Mutual Fund Trade Management Tool.
•	Work on an API interface to Thompson Reuters Beta Systems, which is a global system that manages Mutual Fund accounts and stock transactions.
•	Responsible for performance tuning queries to increase database performance.
•	Acts as the highest-level technical expert for the development team.
•	Technologies used: SQL Server, C#, ASP.NET, VB.NET, MVC, ASP, VB6, HTML, XML, AJAX, TFS, MVC, WCF, Javascript and 3rd party components such as JQuery, Component Art, ActivePDF, ABCPdf and API Access to Thompson Reuters BETA Systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed, developed and implemented a large scale custom shopping cart system, utilizing credit card transactions, for First Horizon Home Loan advisors to order their forms and media from our warehouse.
•	Designed, developed and implemented a large scale safety awareness website used to promote safety in the workplace.  It allows manages to report incidents or record recognition which gives the employees points that can be used to buy products.  It is now used by dozens of companies to promote and track workplace safety, including HB Fuller, McLane Trucking, Weston Bakeries, Bimbo, TXI, Schneider Trucking, Mission Foods, Michaels, Ecolab, Schreiber Foods, ADS, Polypipe, Igloo, Ben E. Keith, Sally Beauty Supply, and Ocean Spray.
•	Designing, developed and implemented a custom digital signage system that is updatable by the client using a custom web application.
•	Designed, developed and implemented many other apps, including: an internal company portal, an email newsletter distribution system,  project tracking system, a customer relations system for sales (similar to Act!), a survey data entry app with reports, a vacation tracking and approval system, 3 different ecommerce sites for selling safety related products.
•	Technologies Used: SQL Server, ASP, ASP.NET, VB.NET, C#, PHP, Visual Studio 6 thru 2010, VB6, ASPPDF, HTML, AJAX, CSS, Javascript, Prototype js, aspSmartUpload.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Responsible for mentoring other developers on the team.
•	Designed, developed and implemented custom solutions for various companies in a team environment. Some of our noteworthy clients were: IESI, American Airlines, and Carrington Labs.
•	Technologies Used: SQL Server, ASP, CSS, HTML, PHP, Cold Fusion, MySql, VB6, C and Serial protocols.

positions.title: Web Applications Developer
positions.description:
•	Was responsible for updates and issue resolution to in-house applications used for sales and customer service agents.
•	Technologies Used: Oracle, ASP, HTML, CSS, Javascript

positions.title: Applications and Systems Developer
positions.description:
•	Maintained various call center apps, using Informix 4GL.
•	Creating new call center apps for new clients.
•	Participated in Research and Development, which brought Web Technology to the company.
•	Technologies Used: Informix 4GL, C, ASP, CGI, Java, TCP/IP protocols, Serial protocols.

positions.title: Com-Center Controller
positions.description:
•	Worked in the Com-Center where we sent and received secure electronic messages to other bases.
•	Assisted contractors from Lockheed Martin in managing the mainframe system and writing scripts to greatly improve efficiency in the com-center.
•	Technologies used: C and scripting for AOS/VS operating system.
